## Corning Weighs AI Optics Tailwind Against iPhone Glass Revenue Uncertainty

GLW sits at the intersection of two live portfolio themes — AI optical interconnect buildout and the Apple hardware cycle — making it a useful barometer for whether AI-materials demand can structurally offset consumer hardware softness.

- GLW is framed as a dual-exposure name: potential upside from AI-driven optical demand, offset by uncertainty around iPhone glass revenue.
- AI infrastructure capex is highlighted as a prospective cash-flow catalyst for Corning.
- Apple supply chain concentration introduces revenue risk tied to AAPL's hardware cycle.
